records.subject: Late Registration Application

records.discussion_summary: The committee reviewed the medical documents provided and noted that as per clause 4.1, no registration shall normally be allowed after the notified last date except in special cases with the permission of the Dean (Academic) or Chairperson, Senate.
records.resolution: Resolved to recommend the late registration request of student M.Tech./CSE/2022/014 to the Dean (Academic) for special approval pursuant to Clause 4.1.

records.subject: Application for Semester Leave
records.facts: Student applied for one semester leave for the ongoing semester due to prolonged chronic health issues requiring surgical intervention and post-operative recovery.
records.discussion_summary: The DMPC verified that the student had not availed any prior semester leave. The medical certificates were inspected and found satisfactory. As per clause 5.2, semester leave up to two semesters may be sanctioned for valid reasons.
records.resolution: Resolved to recommend the sanction of one semester leave for student M.Tech./ECE/2021/008 under Clause 5.2, subject to the approval of the Dean (Academic).

records.subject: Change of Thesis Supervisor

records.resolution: Resolved to approve the change of thesis supervisor for student M.Tech./CE/2022/012 as requested, ensuring continuity of academic advising under Clause 4.2.

records.subject: Stipend Continuation and Attendance Deficiency

records.resolution: Resolved to defer the stipend disbursement clearance for student M.Tech./ECE/2022/045 until proof of attendance regularization and submission of pending progress logs are verified.
